refutation.verdict: The guidance side of the ledger holds up: all 68 guidance rows and 5 aggregate rows were opened (82 distinct URLs, every one loaded), and each date, entity, figure and 'as printed' quote matched the page, including all 11 MSFT transcripts (served as .docx and read from the XML), all 6 CoreWeave PDFs, all 11 Meta exhibit 99.1s, every NBIS 6-K and the Oracle Q1 FY27 release table (28,499 / 11,363 / 17,966 confirmed). All 98 XBRL outturn rows for AMZN, GOOG, META, MSFT, ORCL, CRWV, APLD, WULF, IREN and CIFR reconcile to companyfacts and the cited accession is present for each. The failures are in kind, not in transcription: (1) IREN's us-gaap tag is 'PP&E net of computer hardware', so every IREN outturn row omits the separate 'Payments for computer hardware' line ($1,335.1M in FY26, $799.2M in FY25); true FY26 capex is 4,333.1 not 2,998.0. (2) Cipher folded 'Deposits on equipment' into PP&E purchases in 2026 and recast comparatives, so the CIFR series mixes bases: 2024 is understated by $163M (302.5 vs 139.5) and Q3/Q4 2025 by $0.9M/$3.9M. (3) NBIS 2024 quarters are on the original-release basis (sum 805.2) although later 6-Ks restate Q3 2024 to 172.1 and Q4 to 417.5 (807.5), breaking the ledger's own latest-filed rule. Several amount fields carry the ledger's arithmetic rather than a printed figure (AMZN rows 4 and 5, ORCL rows 145-147 and 151), and the two Value Add VC aggregate rows are one number reported twice. No URL failed to open; no filing-sourced row was absent from its filing; no guidance row was mislabeled as an outturn.
